# Datacenter prefixes used only to drop machine traffic from the analytics daily report.
# Snapshot 2026-09-29. Not a full mirror of every cloud prefix.
# Sources and filters:
# - AWS ip-ranges.json https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json
#   IPv4 prefixes with mask <= 14 (the large published blocks).
# - Google Cloud https://www.gstatic.com/ipranges/cloud.json
#   IPv4 prefixes with mask <= 16. This is cloud.json, not goog.json (Google services / Fiber).
# - DigitalOcean geofeed https://digitalocean.com/geo/google.csv
#   IPv4 prefixes with mask <= 18.
# Smaller prefixes and other clouds: set ANALYTICS_DATACENTER_CIDRS or ANALYTICS_DATACENTER_CIDRS_FILE.
# Cloudflare is intentionally omitted: WARP and a proxied site would hide real visitors.
